A.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create one beautiful 16:9 flat hand-drawn science explainer design, NOT a component sheet. Warm cream #FFFAF0, ink #343C49, yellow #FFDF87, pale blue #8BC7D0, coral #D86856. Spacious editorial layout, title exactly “水为什么会蒸发？”. Show a small sun upper left, center a large simple hand-drawn beaker half full of blue water, six small blue circles rising from water into the upper-right open area, thin broken curved blue trails. A curved dark arrow points toward a tilted yellow label “蒸发” to the right. Below the beaker, “液态 → 气态” is surrounded by a thin coral imperfect oval. Small explanation exactly “水变成水蒸气，进入空气。” No other text.
Implementation contract (mandatory second constraint): A01 label is CSS, flat yellow rectangle with 3px dark border, slightly rounded corners, -2deg tilt and hard dark shadow offset6px, no glass, blur or dimensional extrusion. A02 curved arrow is SVG, a single clean 4px round-cap dark curve with two straight arrowhead strokes; no brush texture, glow, ribbon or depth. A03 emphasis oval is SVG, single coral 4px imperfect line; no marker fill, multiple scratch lines or obscured text. A04 sun is SVG, flat yellow circle with dark outline and exactly eight separate dark rays, no face, glow or shaded sphere. A05 rising particles are Canvas 2D, exactly six plain pale-blue dots with short dashed curved trails, no fog, smoke, realistic droplets or cloud. Beaker illustration is an independent flat image asset: simple thin dark outline, blue water, no photoreal reflections; all labels and relationships stay separate code layers. Typography clean dark sans-serif. Keep these components visually consistent and implementable. Output is a full design reference, not executable code. Never draw A01/A02/A03/A04/A05, CSS/SVG/Canvas labels or production notes in the scene. Do not add extra icons, background patterns, glow, texture, 3D render, shadows other than the hard label shadow, or decorative ornaments.
